title: kc-ship-close-receipt v1
description: What ship-flow hands back to plan-flow when a batch closes. One per batch. Canonical JSON as kc-plan-receipt/v1; close_sha256 computed with its own key removed. The next plan-flow round reads this before station 0.

approval_receipt_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical approval file

minutes.description: per station: dispatch, build, verify, review, deliver; wall-clock excluding quota gaps

residuals.description: review findings outside the Brief, listed for the Captain

accepted_residual.description: why the defect is disposed with no fix ticket; the alternative disposition to fix_ticket. A whitespace-only value does not satisfy this -- validate-receipt.py treats it as absent

defects_returned.description: ship-flow runtime defects this batch surfaced; each entry needs a fix_ticket or an accepted_residual before close (validate-receipt.py refuses one with neither)

dev_debrief.description: written at UAT-ready from the batch's Evidence blocks and refusals, addressed to dev-flow

evidence_refusals.description: this Issue's own WITHOUT_IT_OBSERVED line from its worker-evidence Evidence block, if recorded; accept-station refusals are a separate runtime event this writer does not read

code_refusals.description: refusals sourced from the record -- a README defaults-decision bullet naming this Issue and a REFUSE, or a review/disposition-<PR>.json blocking disposition -- never a copy of `issues[*].residuals`; a single ['source: not recorded'] entry when the record names neither

candidate_correction.description: one candidate correction to the build contract

ship_debrief.description: written after the Captain merges, addressed to ship-flow

overturned.description: true only when a later defaults-decision bullet names this one's timestamp or id together with 'retract', 'overturn', or 'correction'; ship-debrief.py marks the referenced decision, never the later note itself

defaults_decisions.description: every `defaults` decision the batch record made and whether the Captain overturned it
